author: (Günther, 1860)

note.en: A deepwater scorpionfish known from trawls at 80 to 400 m, listed from the Caribbean of Costa Rica by Bussing and López.
note.es: Un rascacio de aguas profundas conocido por arrastres de 80 a 400 m, listado para el Caribe de Costa Rica por Bussing y López.

evidence: Bussing & López 2010 list it for the Caribbean of Costa Rica

sources.t: Bussing & López 2010, Peces costeros del Caribe de Centroamérica meridional, Rev. Biol. Trop. 58 (Suppl. 2)

recWhy: Listed for the Caribbean of Costa Rica[^2]; deepwater, no local site.

marks.en: Red, mottled scorpionfish with a big head, large mouth and venomous spines, with spines on the throat.
marks.es: Rascacio rojo moteado con cabeza grande, boca grande y espinas venenosas, con espinas en la garganta.
